curriculumHighlights.text: Teaching and research sit under seven interdisciplinary schools rather than conventional single-subject departments, so B.Tech branches like Engineering Physics and Mathematics and Computing share a School of Basic Sciences with the institute's science faculty.

sources.title: Academics - IIT Bhubaneswar (seven schools; Basic Sciences houses Engineering Physics and Mathematics and Computing)

curriculumHighlights.text: Five-year dual-degree tracks pair a B.Tech with an M.Tech specialisation in the same school - Civil, Computer Science, Electrical, Mechanical and Metallurgical Engineering all offer one - letting a student exit with both degrees in one extra year.

sources.title: Academics - IIT Bhubaneswar (Dual Degree Programmes table: Civil, CSE, EE, ME, Metallurgical Engineering)

curriculumHighlights.text: IIT Bhubaneswar became the first IIT to give credit for Odissi, a classical Indian dance form, as part of a B.Tech elective, an example of the humanities electives it pairs with core engineering study.

sources.title: Indian Institute of Technology Bhubaneswar - Wikipedia (first IIT to introduce Odissi dance as a credit-bearing B.Tech subject, 2015)

curriculumHighlights.text: A B.Sc.-B.Ed. Integrated Teacher Education Programme, aligned with NEP 2020, trains undergraduates as subject teachers across Economics, Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry alongside the engineering B.Tech intake.

sources.title: Academics - IIT Bhubaneswar (B.Sc.-B.Ed. ITEP programme listing)

research.note: Research spans the seven schools, including a dedicated School of Earth, Ocean and Climate Sciences that is uncommon among IITs. The institute funds work through sponsored research, consultancy and technology-transfer income as part of its stated economic-sustainability goal, and PhD scholars are admitted year-round across all schools rather than in a single annual cycle.
